Ashenvale is in northern Kalimdor. Astranaar, Splintertree Post, The Zoram Strand, Zoram'gar Outpost, Forest Song and Maestra's Post are in Ashenvale.
Astranaar and Forest Song are Alliance travel hubs; Splintertree Post and Zoram'gar Outpost are Horde travel hubs.
Blackfathom Deeps is a dungeon in Ashenvale at the Zoram Strand.
